title: Blowing In The Wind
original_lyrics:
[verse]
How many roads must man walk down

[bridge]
Yes and how many seas must white dove sail

[bridge]
Yes and how many times must the cannon balls fly

[bridge]
The answer my friend is blowing in the wind
The answer is blowing in the wind
How many times must man look up

[bridge]
Yes and how many ears must one man have

[bridge]
Yes and how many deaths will it take till we know
That too many people have died
The answer my friend is blowing in the wind
The answer is blowing in the wind
How many years can mountain exist

[bridge]
Yes and how many years can some people exist

[bridge]
Yes and how many times can man turn his head
Pretending he just doesn't see
The answer my friend is blowing in the wind
The answer is blowing in the wind
